title: Geek Bar Pulse Blue Razz Ice 15000 Disposable Vape
description:
Geek Bar Pulse Blue Razz Ice 15000 Disposable Vape
Learn about the Blue Razz Ice Geek Bar Pulse 15000 Disposable Vape, a cutting-edge gadget made for discriminating fans. This disposable vape has an amazing 15,000 puff lifetime. It has a 16mL capacity and two power levels, so you can enjoy a lengthy and pleasurable draw.
Relish Your Taste Buds
The wonderful Blue Razz Ice taste profile is a refreshing vaping pleasure that combines the tart scent of luscious blue raspberries with a cool menthol undertone. The Blue Razz Ice Geek Bar Pulse 15000 Disposable Vape is perfect for those who like strong tastes and a durable vaping experience. It offers ease and excellent enjoyment. Use this amazing gadget to enhance your vaping experience.
Profile of Blue Razz Ice Flavor
A delicious explosion of blue raspberry, the Blue Razz Ice flavor profile is an award-winning vaping pleasure. This delicious flavor has a mellow, somewhat sweet taste that is enhanced by subtle, creamy overtones for more depth and richness. The subtle hint of chili menthol, which arouses the senses and adds to the whole experience, is what distinguishes this taste.
The harmonic mix of delicate creaminess, minty freshness, and tart blue raspberry appeals to vapers who want a well-balanced and enjoyable vaping experience. The Blue Razz Ice flavor delivers a delicious blend that is sure to capture the taste and make a lasting impression, regardless of your preference for fruity flavors, creamy undertones, or a hint of menthol.
More Features
Battery Capacity : 650mAh
Puffs : 15000 puffs
E-Liquid Capacity : 10ml
Nicotine Strength : 5%
Mesh Coil
Rechargeable
FAQ
What is the Blue Razz Ice flavor profile?
The Blue Razz Ice flavor combines the tart taste of blue raspberries with a cool menthol undertone, creating a balanced and refreshing vaping experience with subtle creamy overtones.
Is the e-liquid preloaded?
Yes, the device comes preloaded with 16ml of e-liquid, ensuring a lengthy vaping session without the need for a refill.
How do I activate the device?
The Geek Bar Pulse Blue Razz Ice features a draw-activated mechanism, so simply inhale on the mouthpiece to activate the device.
What is included with the purchase of the Geek Bar Pulse Blue Razz Ice?
The package includes one Geek Bar Pulse rechargeable device. A USB Type-C cable for recharging the battery is not included and must be purchased separately.
